missions.title: Echo Under the Ice
missions.description: Investigate a repeating distress signal bouncing off Glacius ice rings.

missions.title: Smuggler Ledger
missions.description: Recover a smuggler ledger from Sol customs patrol before it is erased.

missions.title: The Drifter's Debt
missions.description: Help a stranded captain and claim rights to their exclusive chassis design.

missions.title: Gate in the Centauri Shadows
missions.description: Locate the hidden gate in Alpha Centauri by approaching it closely, then report your findings to Alpha Centauri station.

missions.title: Taurus Horns: Fall of Zeus
missions.description: Hunt down and destroy the capital ship Zeus in Taurus Horns. Military channels open after victory.

missions.title: Chaos Gate Clearance
missions.description: At a military station, purchase a Jared Chaos Gate Matrix to unlock chaos gate traversal, then proceed to Nyx Fall.

missions.title: Raid Over Alpha Centauri
missions.description: Defeat a pirate raid in Alpha Centauri and extract intel: Jared outfits are being sold in the Nemo system.

missions.title: Nemo Exchange
missions.description: Travel to Nemo, equip Jared outfits, and attempt the hidden jump route from Alpha Centauri.

missions.title: Relic of Cooperation
missions.description: In Smuggler's Den, investigate a relic starship to uncover the truth: Jareds and humans were meant to cooperate.

missions.title: Cartographer of Tortuga
missions.description: Find the Turtuk star map on Tortuga and secure stealth outfits needed for deep infiltration.

missions.title: Edge of Mutual Destruction
missions.description: In Turtuk, learn Jareds and humans are near total war. Head north to LX1 to contact technician specialists.

missions.title: Warfield Singularity Escort
missions.description: Escort a technician singularity vessel through Warfield and witness the scale of sector-wide devastation.

missions.title: Echoes of Ancestral Humanity
missions.description: At Gargantua, protect the technician singularity pilot during weapon recharge. You learn technicians are ancestral humans and unlock technician ship purchases at LX1 and Far Space 1.
